segments.text: I'll contact you guys after I arrive in Shanghai.
Find a translator within three hours and have him come to the hotel.
It's hard for both sides to speak English.
I agreed to meet the client at Korea Hotel.
I heard that he likes to eat Korean food.
Okay.
Please put your luggage on the scale.
What is it?
I'll go right away.
Sir!
Sir!
This thing was in your pant pocket.
Really?
My finger's slimmed down a bit lately.
Who's Hyo Jin?
I know that at a time like this I shouldn't be saying this, but, which Hyo Jin?
Lee Jong Rok!
The number you are dialing because of the client's...
What?
Don't joke around.
I'll go right now.
Where are you going?
If you dare to leave right now, we'll divorce immediately.
This is more urgent.
Even if I divorce, I have to go.
Cheers!
Cheers!
President Im, sing a song.
Sing a fun one.
How did you know that I'm good at singing?
We'll not only sing one song,
I'm the King of Playlists.
Excuse me.
What are you doing?
I have an emergency.
President Im, what does that mean?
Do you not plan on signing the contract?
I'm sorry.
It's something more important than signing a contract.
Hey!
President Im!
Yoon!
Yoon!
It's all right, I'm all right.
The two black lines worn on the mourning band signifies immediate family member.
One black line means that they're friends or close to the family.
One line on your arm, one in your heart.
Those guys wore two black lines.
I encountered the most painful separation in my life, but I also gained my best luck.
Seo Yi Soo
Where are you?
What sort of call is it?
I said before to not speak to me.
Who is it?
Who cares about who it is?
Who is it?
It's my mom.
Actually, my mom abandoned her own child to raise someone else's children for 20 years.
Do you want to come and listen to her experience?
If you don't want to go together, then let go.
Fine.
Let's go together.
What will happen?
Will you cry alone?
Did you return home safely?
Rather than worrying myself, it's better that I go with you.
My daughter's very pretty.
How long has it been since we've met?
This is the first time since you turned 30, right?
Why don't you answer your phone?
We aren't the type to exchange greetings.
I contacted you because something happened.
What?
Why is it that you want to see me?
The sons from Sung Book Dong, did they not come to see you?
How did they not?
They called and harassed me.
Why are they torturing me like this?
They're of no relation to me.
Why do they have to do this to me?
It's obvious.
An inheritance war between the stepmom and the children.
They want to persuade you to tear me away.
Their father is about to leave this world.
I beg you.
I am really completely uninterested in your life.
Starting from when I was 12 years old, there is no such thing as a mom in my life.
Why are you doing this to me?
If mom changes her destiny, then she thought that her child's destiny would also change.
I couldn't do anything for you, so I wanted to change my destiny for you.
Nothing ever goes as you wish in life.
I don't want to listen.
When did I ever ask you to do anything for me?
Are you really not at all sorry towards me?
What do you want me to do now that things are the way they are?
Their thinking is to divorce rather than inherit the wealth.
24 years is nothing to them.
So no matter what they say, do not meet with them.
I'll take care of everything else.
The only thing of Quartz Island that is left is the presentation.
I'll let you, Director Shin take care of that.
Starting from today, Young Ran and Director Choi are responsible for this case.
A terraced development.
Terrace?
Yes, duplex townhouse.
You were there right?
Ask Director Choi for the details.
All right.
But what about President Kim?
Why is our Young Ran so curious about so many things?
President Kim needed to take care of something so he's outside.
Don't bother him for this time period.
He's out on business, abroad, to experience new things.
What are you talking about?
Why'd you come?
I told you to rest.
I didn't do anything, what do you mean rest?
Are you guys in charge of the duplex project?
Yes.
I'll take this.
You go work on other things.
Are you really all right?
Do you need to go live in the mountains for a few days?
I've got to work.
Where are you guys?
We just started.
Then, I'm going to go to the site.
I told them to meet at 4.
Are you going to come?
Fine.
It's a 44-unit townhouse complex.
Because the target clients are young, in their 30s and 40s,
the whole complex must tell a single story.
I see there are no fences and that the yard is all a jointly owned common area.
The concept is the home with a loft that city people dream of.
Ah, I love lofts.
Will someone build a house like that for me?
The mini house and the presentation have to be prepared at the same time.
It's always like that.
Hi!
Hi!
My friend!
Why are you guys dressed like that?
It's not the style that we want either.
It's a style concept that has meaning.
You're the only one.
What?
Are we going to audition to be comedians?
Look!
He laughed.
It's been a long time since you laughed.
Did you guys dress up like this and wait for me just to make me laugh?
Even if the whole world laughs at us, as long as you're happy, it's all good.
Even if the whole universe laughed, we would do it.
Hurry and come sit!
We need the normal you.
You crazy guys.
Don't worry about the company.
Take care of the kid.
Don't worry about the kid.
Just worry about Teacher Seo.
You guys can't even take care of yourselves.
I think so.
The first is me.
Your phone's vibrating.
I know.
It's Se Ra.
If I answer then she's not going to look for me.
Wear it.
Because it's so embarrassing you won't think of anything else for at least 30 minutes.
I'm going back to the office.
Then, if you wear this too,
add another 20 minutes.
I'm going up, too.
Wait a moment.
They're joking.
About what?
How could I not think about other things?
Seo Yi Soo has a dress that's this color.
Hey, everyone has that color.
It's a really common color.
Because she wears it uncommonly.
What will happen?
Will you cry alone?
Did you return home safely?
Rather than worrying myself, it's better that I go with you.
I just called you.
I know.
How did you know it was me?
Because I was watching you.
Why are you here?
Can I not be here?
Is this area all yours?
Did you come to see me?
There's no other reason.
I didn't cry and I got home safely.
Why would I be here then?
Did you wait for a long time?
You don't need to know.
Did you eat?
No.
Is there a movie you want to watch?
No.
Do you want to take a walk?
No.
Should I keep standing or should I go in?
Why are you asking me that?
Do you want to keep standing or go in?
Do you miss me or not?
Do you want to try to hold onto me or do you not want to?
Answer me.
I'm really curious.
I heard that the ethics teacher is dating a man with a child.
Is she crazy?
Why would a perfectly good woman go date a man with a kid?
There must be something wrong with the woman, too.
People hang out with people who are like them.
That is how the world perceives you.
I love Seo Yi Soo enough not to make her into a flawed woman.
So...
I have something to tell you.
Wearing that?
Is there something you need to argue with me about?
That's for later.
I'm planning on selling this house.
What?
The cash amount is too high.
I can't afford it anymore.
I've also delayed payments on the interest.
This house was always a little extravagant.
So was the car.
So I haven't seen your car in a few days because...
Yeah, anyway, after I sell the house, I'll repay your money first.
So you should go look for a place.
Then what are you going to do?
I'll have to move to a place that suits me, too.
Will there be a buyer for the house?
Right now who...
The conditions that I ask for are enticing.
I heard that someone's already come by to look.
Sorry for not being able to tell you earlier.
Then, I'm going to my next schedule.
How do you feel?
About what?
Seeing me at the end of my wits, how do you feel?
Lower your voice.
This is the office.
Who told you to force me to come here to see you?
I repaid the money for you so now you can begin looking for me.
Is that what it means?
Do you think I'll show my face in front of you just because you repaid my debt?
If you were that type of woman, we would definitely be happier than we are right now.
Don't pretend to be a good person.
Don't pretend to be a good man.
You should've stayed out of it.
You should have just done nothing.
I will find a way to deal with it.
How can I do nothing and just watch?
I'm going to go crazy.
What else can I do?
Even so, you shouldn't have.
In the future, how can I come back to you?
I'm so embarrassed.
Did you even think about coming back to me?
I'm on my way.
But who told you to watch me at my wit's ends.
Even if the whole world knew, Im Tae San shouldn't know.
I'm in the middle of a meeting.
Stop lying.
Your mom's in Seoul right now.
In the hospital.
The hospital?
Why?
Are you feeling unwell?
Of course I'm feeling unwell.
Why else would I be in the hospital?
I'm in the hospital that's near your neighborhood.
Where in the neighborhood?
Myung In Hospital?
Yeah, first floor.
A white dress.
I got it.
I'll go right now.
Is your mother not feeling well?
I'm going to go see.
She knew that you don't like blind dates so she thought of this method.
Yes, it seems so.
I don't really care about a man's age.
What?
I'm afraid that you feel burdened.
Oh, is that so?
I heard that you're an architect.
They say I'm an architect, but really I'm a carpenter.
I'm sorry, but what is your profession?
The president of this hospital's daughter.
This is my dad's hospital.
My dad said that I'm at the age to marry, so I should marry.
Is that so?
I'm okay with two or three.
What?
Kids.
I can at least have one every two years.
Meals, I plan on making two a day with my own hands.
Making three a day is a bit too much.
Yes.
If you think I'm cute, then you can laugh out loud.
You're really a perfect bride.
Everything's good.
But other people, if they like me too much then they don't contact me anymore.
I've already said everything that I want to say.
If you would like to continue then please say it before 6.
Goodbye.
Why did you come?
Because your mother seemed to be sick, although it was a bit ridiculous.
This girl seems to be not bad.
Marry her.
I don't think she's bad, either.
She'll make two meals a day and give birth to one child every two years.
I lost.
I'm not trying to be mean.
I never thought of marriage.
Even if I did, how can I compete with her?
The money, if it's fast then I'll be able to repay it by the end of this month.
Then, goodbye.
Hong Se Ra.
Don't worry, I won't bother you anymore.
Are you really...
You must win.
I can't wait for you for too long.
What are you doing?
Do you think I'm really pitiful?
You wanna die?
I love you!
Come here!
Good morning, beautiful.
Get on.
Are you asking me to sit on the back of this?
Thinking about it, you've probably ridden in all the expensive cars in our country.
But possibly, no one has asked you to ride on the back seat of a bicycle.
You'll think that the world in front of your eyes is like a music video.
Hop on.
Hold on tightly.
Tightly.
I told you to hold on tightly.
You never want to listen.
Do you know?
Out of all the women that I've dated,
you're the shortest, most short-tempered, oldest, and the most un-cute.
To be honest, what do you have besides money?
Having money, of course ,is a good thing.
My back's sweating.
So tiring.
Anyway, even though you have those shortcomings, you're really like poison.
So in the future you should be like you are now.
Stick to my back closely.
Got it?
I got it, but how do you unlock this?
You weren't listening to it?
It has to make noise for me to listen.
It's locked.
Everything that I said, you heard all of it?
Yeah, starting from "Get on" to "got it".
In the middle you said that I was short, the oldest...
So embarrassing.
So embarrassing!
You're loud.
Sit back on.
Really.
Honey, the words that I said in the middle...
Look forward.
Onward!
I'm going to go crazy.
Why are you here?
I'm looking for a chair.
Where are you going to put it?
Am I being a bit too insensitive right now?
Something appealing to a teenager.
I'm not an expert either.
If it's something appealing to a teenager, then...
Yes, I plan on living with him for a period of time.
It's hard, isn't it?
In between a woman and a kid, should you be a man or should you be a father?
I met with Teacher Seo a few days ago.
She seemed to be having a hard time.
If a man says I love you, then even if you die you will not say this next thing.
Do you know what it is?
I'm sorry.
Something so simple, men don't seem to understand.
Bye.
You like it?
Your architecture career, are you sure it's going well?
What's this?
There needs to be a color point according to the style concept.
A fabric sofa is the basics of having a kid.
I'm not 9, but 19.
It's the color and fabric that I chose considering that you're 19.
What did you do?
I remade it into a warm room filled with dreams and hope.
Dreams and hope.
Make it as it was.
It doesn't match the concept right now.
If you give me more allowance then I'll think about it.
50,000 a week, is that too little?
My mom gave me 10,000 yen a week.
Is that reasonable?
That's 150,000 won.
Tokyo's cost of living is high.
I'm going to text your mom to confirm...
I got it.
Give me half of that.
From now on you'll get 30,000 each week.
If you lie you should be punished.
You'd better not do this.
Hello?
We're the real estate company.
You're selling your house, aren't you?
I think you've called the wrong number.
Are you not #702's Kim Do Jin?
Your son came and asked us to call you.
Do you hate me?
Do you plan on using 20 years' worth of rebellion at once?
I'm sorry.
I went a bit overboard.
Fine.
Then let's resolve it like this.
I want you to go to school.
I won't stay in Korea for long.
Even if you're only here for a few days you should go to school.
Why?
When I was in high school I met your Uncles Tae San, Yoon, and Jung Rok.
Regarding transferring schools, Uncle Yoon already has taken care of it.
And this isn't a discussion, it's informative.
Korean dads are like that.
Where's the Korean dad going?
That's my personal life.
You don't need to care.
I saw it when I was shopping and thought it was pretty so I bought it.
Don't feel burdened by it.
It's the exact same as mine!
I was just thinking why did I immediately see it and want to buy it?
Why did you hide it?
Did you steal it?
Me Ah Ri, I think she got me a couples' bracelet or something.
At her age, that's what they do.
But you still accepted it.
I just picked up what she threw away.
Stupid.
Then what about you?
Who said I wasn't?
What about Colin's school?
I just have to take care of one thing and it'll be done.
I'll take care of it tomorrow.
Hello, Teacher Seo.
Can we meet?
There's something I would like to discuss with you.
On the way here, I thought about it.
About what it is that you would like to speak to me about.
What do you think it is?
That child, he wants to stay right?
In Korea.
If he stays in Korea, then he's probably decided to live with Kim Do Jin.
Actually...
Yes.
It's probably out of responsibility, or you could call it guilt.
Following Kim Do Jin's personality, I already predicted that much.
So I can already guess at what you would like to say.
If you would like to discuss this issue with me as a teacher,
then it's probably about the child's schooling.
Yes.
Where he's staying now, the possible schools he can transfer to includes yours.
If you feel uncomfortable about it, I will eliminate that school from the list.
That's what I was planning on doing.
He can probably count on one hand how many people he knows in Korea.
It would probably be a little better if at least I were there.
Should I say thank you or sorry?
It isn't the child's fault.
I'm transferring to this school.
I know.
Second year class 2 is at the end of this walkway.
I'm your homeroom teacher.
I'm planning on staying with ahjusshi.
I heard.
Are you still calling him ahjusshi?
Still.
My mom already left.
She's a good person.
You met my mom?
One time by chance and one time we agreed to meet.
Do you not feel uncomfortable meeting me?
I've never felt uncomfortable meeting a student of mine.
If you don't study hard though, you'll feel uncomfortable about meeting me.
I'm sorry.
As long as you know.
You're not going to skip school anymore, right?
I'm going to try.
A man should at least graduate from high school.
That's right.
It'd be even better if you had a dream.
Go in.
You start school on Monday.
Tell your parents to come.
Why?
It's a part of my education philosophy to meet with a transfer student's parents.
Your son's situation, he's already at the age where he should be in his 3rd year.
But because he's lived abroad for a long period of time,
he may not be able to keep up with his work, so we chose to put him in the 2nd year class.
Our class is focused on liberal arts.
Did you hear my words?
Do you know what areas your son usually shows interest in?
I think he knows how to play a little guitar.
Have you asked him before about his dreams and aspirations for the future?
We're not that close, yet.
What is your dream?
Are we also not that close yet?
The conference is over.
You may leave now.
Transfer students first must set their character.
Only that way can your school life go smoothly.
Do you know how scary Korean high school students can be?
Your dad in high school...
You.
Anyway, in Korea, only seniority in age works.
In other words, win by seniority.
Being older by a year, you must make that apparent.
But they definitely don't place last when it comes to being rude.
Grab the first opportunity.
You must first assert yourself.
People who assert themselves have at least 50% chance of succeeding.
When you're going to school, just kick open the door.
And then those kids will all stare at you like this.
And then, say this:
"Who's the leader in this class?"
Like that.
Does that move still work in the twenty first century?
That move always works.
And then, you must control them.
You don't have to fight with them.
How?
This time, I wish to quietly graduate.
Help me out here.
Like that.
And then, your eyes.
I guarantee they'll be scared out of their wits.
But, are we supposed to teach him these things?
Real uncles start the teaching from the bad things.
You went to exercise again?
I thought I was naturally born to.
Seems like it was all luck.
I just rested for a few days and I'm all out of shape.
Someone's going to come look at the house tomorrow.
They came in the day, but no one was home so they left.
Are you planning on selling it that fast?
It seems like I should start looking for a place to move to.
Have you been looking?
I just looked at some ads online for apartments around the school.
What about you?
Me?
Well, I'm looking for a single.
A single?
I'll find a big one.
A big single room.
Hong Se Ra.
Endure it.
Lately I've gained more and more sympathy by the day lately.
I'm starting to fall into the category of pitiful.
Monthly rent?
I don't care.
Let's not talk about this anymore and talk about something else.
Should I tell you an interesting story?
He's in our class.
Kim Do Jin's son.
What?!
You endure it, too.
It was avoidable, but I didn't avoid it.
Why in the world did you not?
Because even though I've broken up with Kim Do Jin, I can still meet with him.
If I call him, then he'll come.
Because he is the student's parent.
Have you guys already completely broken up?
I don't know, either.
He's not trying to hold onto me.
I don't know what he's done right exactly either.
Of course he's not able to hold onto you!
Try changing perspectives.
If for example you suddenly have a kid out of the blue,
but to Kim Do Jin, you say I suddenly have a kid, even though it's not your kid,
but since we love each other, it's all okay right?
Would you say that?
Or say, I'll give you time, so can you decide whether or not you want to break up with me.
Would you be like that?
Even if it were me, I wouldn't be able to hold onto you.
With what conscience are you able to?
How can you adapt so quickly?
You're just a transfer student.
Do Japanese students come to the nurse's office when they want to skip class, too?
I didn't go to school when I was in Japan.
What in the world?
That's awesome.
Did your family not say anything?
How did they not?
All the parents in the world have the same character.
Don't ask any more about it.
My birth is a secret.
[KOSDAQ] (*T/N: Korean stock market)
Do you know what kind of world you're going to have to face in the future?
What?
In our country, if you don't have money, then you have to study.
Are you good at studying?
I don't want to study.
I just need to have money.
Then, how are you going to make money?
Aren't I figuring that out right now?
You're blatantly skipping class?!
Do you think this is university?
How long has it been since you transferred here and you're already skipping class?
How long ago did you say I'm sorry and you're already skipping?
Write three pages of repentance.
You tell your parents to come.
Your son's skipping class.
He's only transferred here for three days.
I'm also skipping work to be here.
You asked me to come at this time period, so I didn't have a choice.
Then "That won't work.
I can't go.
I don't want to."
Why didn't you say that?
Because I was curious.
What is it?
Are you saying that you miss me?
Let me give you another suggestion.
Although I've never done this before,
but from you, I can make an exception and receive a gift from you.
I'll text you the place.
Please always have your phone with you.
Are you serious?
The hot man that Teacher Seo brought?
Yeah.
I heard that man is a dad, a parent.
That kid that transferred from Japan.
What is this?!
What's going on?
No wonder.
I was curious about how normal he was.
Is he a divorcee then?
Is he?
I don't know the details.
Seriously.
She's always talking about nurturing morals, ethics and what not.
Always acting like she's all that.
And he turns out to be a man with a kid.
So it's his second marriage!
His second!
Is he super rich?
He must be, must be rich.
Or else, is she crazy?
Why would she ruin her own life?
Teacher Seo, I couldn't tell that you were that good.
I'll accept the gift this weekend.
Saturday, 2pm.
Don't schedule anything else.
Today's goal is a picnic.
It's an educational program.
Have a seat.
I asked you to have a seat, Colin's dad.
As the place where you accept a gift, this place is a bit too open.
That's right, you like places with four walls don't you?
We'll go to a place like that next time.
Since we're here for a picnic, let's have a lunch box.
I didn't give it to you so that you could eat it.
I gave it to you so that you can feed it to me.
From morning I started battling as if I were in war, trying to make this food.
Feed it to me.
You should eat, too.
I think I really do like you very much, Kim Do Jin.
Even though you admitted to being a child's father, I still like you.
I thought that if after meeting you today,
I would see you tomorrow and feel annoyed, and then I wouldn't be so insistent.
But every time I see you, I surrender.
My heart falls with a loud "thump".
I'm tired to death of trying to hold back my tears.
In this kind of situation, how can we break up?
It's not the correct choice.
Considering your position, you shouldn't be giving me advice.
I know that you're acting like this because you're afraid that you're being immoral.
But, you love me, right?
Because I love you, should I hold on to you?
Because I love you, should I always be around you?
Even if there weren't any obstacles, people break up.
But we...
A woman like you has no reason to take this suffocating road.
I said that I wanted to walk down this path.
You just have to stand at the end of that path.
What exactly is it that you're thinking?
This...
I don't think it's my heart beat.
If you don't want to admit it, then just pretend that it's mine.
Let's eat.
What are you doing?
Why are you not coming in?
What are you doing?
Why are you not sitting?
I'm sleepy.
You need to soothe me until I fall asleep.
You should keep petting my hair until I become bald.
I'm trying hard.
Can you not tell?
I've already done so much.
Even if you can't do it, you should at least follow me.
Since breaking up with you, I haven't had one nights' good sleep.
So, come over and soothe me to bed.
Hurry.
Please.
How can you come looking for me at my house?
If you keep acting like this, we might even come visit you at your school.
You received that text, right?
I told you to bring your seal and seal of proof.
Why should I listen to you guys?
Don't waste any more time.
No matter what, she is a woman that's stayed in our house for more than ten years.
We understand that, too.
If you don't want to be embarrassed in front of everyone,
then hurry and put an end to this matter.
It's 24 years.
What?
She's stayed in your house for 24 years.
That woman that you keep speaking of.
What are you doing?
We're not done talking.
It's me.
How much money did you get, Mom?
How much is it that we have to go this far?
This woman's crazy.
You abandon your kid and have lived for 24 years.
Can you not even justly receive that much money?
Why do you have to live like that?!
Why?
Anyway, things are already like this.
Although I don't know how much their inheritance is worth, get it all.
Got it?!
You really...
You already look poor enough.
Your mom served our old witch before, too.
The amount that we give won't disappoint her.
Settle.
We won't sue.
Cleanly move out of this house.
That's about what's inside.
What is the use if I settle an issue between you and my mom that you have to go this far?
It involves your family.
If you say you got the money and stamped your seal will she be able to persist?
If she persists till the end, then is she still a human being?
She'd be a beggar.
What did you say?!
I sure want to...
Have you seen someone who's lost money be able to be calm?
We've been treating you nicely.
Do you think we're funny?
I dare you to try running away.
We'll overturn your house and school.
I won't run away.
She's a stupid one, too.
Pretend like before never happened.
Stop being angry.
We still have things to take care of.
Excuse me.
You need to pay.
I'm sorry.
How much is it?
What?
3 cups of coffee plus 3 coffee sets and glass mugs with handles...
It includes the chair cleaning fee, too.
What does that mean?
How annoying.
A while ago your brothers came and made this mess.
Since your brothers caused the mess, then you should take responsibility, no?
Brothers?
I'm going to go crazy.
